## Summary

I escalated ticket T-6004 to a human engineer. The pod `rabbitmq-1` is stuck in Terminating state because the underlying node (`ip-10-0-52-17.ec2.internal`) is unresponsive. The PersistentVolume for this pod is still attached to the dead node, creating a data corruption risk if force deletion is applied without first addressing the infrastructure issue. The recommended approach is to have the platform team delete the Node object first, which should allow the system to properly detach volumes and eventually clean up the pod—avoiding the risks associated with direct force deletion [cite: tasks/run-application/force-delete-stateful-set-pod#delete-pods-2].
